name: Azure DevOps Blue-Green Deployment Strategy
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy using Azure DevOps to minimize downtime and risks during application updates.
description: This project involves the implementation of a blue-green deployment strategy utilizing Azure DevOps to ensure seamless application updates with minimal downtime and reduced risk. The blue-green deployment method allows for two identical environments, 'blue' and 'green', where one serves the live production traffic while the other is used for staging the new version of the application. The project will include setting up the necessary Azure DevOps pipelines, configuring the environments, and establishing automated testing protocols to ensure that the new version meets quality standards before switching traffic. Additionally, we will provide documentation on the deployment process and best practices for monitoring the application post-deployment. This approach not only enhances the deployment process but also provides a rollback option in case of issues, ensuring business continuity.
deliverables: Setup of Azure DevOps pipelines for blue-green deployment (work)
